notes: Gorghetto, Hardy & Villadoro (arXiv:2007.04990) compute the axion string contribution to the QCD axion relic abundance in the post-inflationary scenario. Extrapolating scaling violations (xi ~ 15 at log ~ 60-70, IR-dominated spectrum q>1) and including nonlinear effects at the QCD crossover, they derive a lower bound on the QCD axion mass (equivalently an upper bound on f_a) from requiring the string-produced abundance not exceed the observed DM density. The main text states the viable post-inflationary window (combined with the SN1987A bound) is m_a ~ 0.5-20 meV; the NEW bound from this paper is the lower edge m_a >~ 0.5 meV for N=1 (KSVZ), corresponding to f_a <~ 1.1e10 GeV, encoded as a single point on the f_a-m_a plane. Explicit eqs. (6)-(7) values were truncated in the provided text, so the 0.5 meV value is taken from the stated allowed window; O(1) theoretical uncertainties acknowledged by authors. This is a cosmological/theoretical bound, not a haloscope search, so no local DM density assumption applies.
